body.label: Target
body.html: One enemy within melee Weapon Range.

body.label: Effect
body.html: On success, deal 2 weapon Damage. The target suffers -1 on its next Success Die against a creature other than you until the start of your next turn.

surges.html: On a hit, the target is Slowed 1 until the start of your next turn.
Gain +1 Fortitude against the target until the start of your next turn.

rider.title: Authority - Example
rider.html: Spend this Authority when the target attacks an ally before your next turn: after its attack, move 1 unit toward it and make yourself Rallied.
